2893-3470-7886-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1479-2783-2841-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2783-2841-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Nesting Dragon and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Nesting Dragon triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-7084-7893.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2852-3629-8089.easyPrerequisites:
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
Your life total is even.
2852-3629-8089.description:
Activate Doom Whisperer by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

950-1636-2681-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1843-3259-5434.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-5434.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-1355-4359.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-4359.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3605-4812-5147-5987.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3858-7132.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Super-Skrull's second ability by paying {3}{G}, giving Super-Skrull +4/+4 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until Super-Skrull has power 19 or greater.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

1453-4559-5226-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-5226-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4053-5499-7296--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5499-7296--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2769-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2769-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

777-4002-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
777-4002-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

372-4681-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1374-3626-5499-7060--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-5499-7060--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

681-5414-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5414-6621-6664.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2034-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2034-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

2173-2438-5220-6538.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

339-677-4050-4785.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1921-2034-2423.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Bounding Krasis from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Bounding Krasis token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Bounding Krasis token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Bounding Krasis token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

3771-4484-4871-5643-6797.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3771-4484-4871-5643-6797.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
3771-4484-4871-5643-6797.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3771-4484-4871-5643-6797.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-586-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

880-4862-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4862-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2043-2713-4715-4772.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

390-3362.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Hulking Metamorph
390-3362.description:
Cast Hulking Metamorph by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Hulking Metamorph's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

891-2386-2511-5220.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2386-2511-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1308-1651-2034-2797.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

262-2178-2899.notablePrerequisites: Elemental Mastery and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature with power 1 or greater that does not have summoning sickness.
262-2178-2899.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
The Elemental(s) enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Elemental(s) die, the creature with Thornbite Staff attached triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Repeat.

6-1284-3341.notablePrerequisites:
Charnelhoard Wurm does not have summoning sickness.
Viridian Longbow attached to Charnelhoard Wurm.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}.
6-1284-3341.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {G}.
Activate Charnelhoard Wurm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Charnelhoard Wurm triggers, returning Vitalize to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Vitalize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}, this combo will net infinite mana.

711-4067-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Fallowsage does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Fallowsage.
711-4067-4474.description:
Activate Fallowsage by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Fallowsage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Fallowsage.
Repeat.

2034-2233-3048.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Grim Betrayal has at least one indestructible counter on it.
2034-2233-3048.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Roalesk, adding {C}{C}.
When Roalesk dies, its second ability triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, returning Roalesk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Roalesk enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any creature you control.
Repeat.

4222-4474-4639.notablePrerequisites: Paradise Mantle and Freed from the Real attached to the same blue creature without summoning sickness.
4222-4474-4639.description:
Activate the creature with Paradise Mantle and Freed from the Real attached by tapping it, adding {U}.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

3069-3465-4050-4840.description:
Activate Myr Battlesphere's unearth ability by paying {1}{B}{R}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing two Myr tokens and Myr Battlesphere, adding {1}{B}{R}.
Choose to exile Myr Battlesphere using Void Maw's replacement effect instead of its unearth replacement effect.
Activate Void Maw by putting Myr Battlesphere from exile into your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
